tracks.theme: Mid-July cool-green escape - the plains bake above 40C while Srinagar wakes near 15C: emerald meadows, Mughal gardens in full bloom, the Dal glass-still at dawn
tracks.subject: Kashmir stays green and cool while the plains bake

tracks.theme: Yatra-week loss-aversion - airport runs, Pahalgam/Sonamarg drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
tracks.subject: A Yatra-week ride just went to a listed driver

tracks.theme: Mid-July Dal Lake demand and loss-aversion - cool monsoon nights, travellers wanting the real houseboat stay; the unlisted boat loses tonight's guest to a listed one
tracks.subject: A cool Dal Lake night just booked another houseboat
